This appendix contains past quizzes from when I've taught the course.
I administer one quiz per week,
for a total of fourteen quizzes per semester.
The quizzes are paired, such that I use the highest score from quizzes 1 and 2,
quizzes 3 and 4, quizzes 5 and 6, and so forth.
This allows students to miss a quiz without me having to schedule a make-up.
It also allows students a second opportunity to demonstrate mastery of the
material if they made mistakes the first time.
The material on the quizzes is cumulative throughout the semester,
so the last two quizzes are effectively comprehensive final exams,
except they're worth the same as all the other quizzes,
and if you don't like your score on the first one, you can take the second one.
